theses.thesis: T1: Value-added services keep outgrowing the payment network, lifting margins and mix.
theses.signpost: VAS net revenue growth at or above 15% excluding acquisitions in each 2026 quarterly report, with gross margin at or above 77.9% (Q2 2026 onward). Invalidated if VAS growth falls below network growth or gross margin drops below 76.3%.

theses.thesis: T2: Earnings momentum continues, so consensus EPS estimates are achievable.
theses.signpost: FY2026 reported EPS at or above $20.06 in the February 2027 10-K, and the next quarterly EPS beat continues. Invalidated by a quarterly EPS miss or a 90-day consensus cut above 5%.

theses.thesis: T3: At the current price, the stock returns less than its cost of capital unless revenue growth beats consensus for years.
theses.signpost: FY2026 revenue at or above $37.4 billion consensus, growth near 14%, and the stock near $635. Invalidated by FY2026 revenue growth below 12%, or a sustained price decline that lifts the implied return above the 8.8% WACC.

theses.thesis: T1: Value-added services keep outgrowing the payment network, so blended revenue growth stays at or above 13% in FY2026.
theses.signpost: VAS net revenue growth at or above 20% in each 2026 quarterly filing; invalidated by VAS growth below 15% in two consecutive quarters or FY2026 reported revenue growth below 12%.

theses.thesis: T2: Operating leverage persists: operating margin stays at or above 57% in FY2026 as adjusted opex grows slower than revenue.
theses.signpost: Quarterly operating margin at or above 57% and adjusted opex growth below revenue growth in each 2026 10-Q; invalidated by FY2026 operating margin below 55% or adjusted opex growth above revenue growth in two consecutive quarters.

theses.thesis: T3: Returns will lag the cost of capital unless revenue compounds near 13.5% a year, because the current price already assumes that growth.
theses.signpost: FY2026 reported revenue growth of at least 13.5% and FY2026 EPS of at least $20.00, confirmed in the FY2026 10-K; invalidated by FY2026 revenue growth below 12% or FY2027 consensus revenue below $41.4 billion.

theses.thesis: T4: Regulatory action on interchange and switching is the main threat to growth, and tightening in a major market would push growth below consensus.
theses.signpost: A new interchange or cross-border switching rule adopted in a major market, or the Regulation II court outcome, reported in quarterly filings; invalidated by no material new rule in 2026 with FY2026 litigation charges below $504 million and growth in line with consensus.
